project_idea: AI-powered demand forecasting for Indian retail sales

feasibility.project_title: AI-powered demand forecasting for Indian retail sales
feasibility.problem_statement: Indian retail stores, particularly SMEs, struggle with inventory management due to demand volatility caused by localized factors like regional festivals, weather patterns, and supply chain disruptions, leading to either stockouts or overstocking.
required_resources: Cloud computing credits (e.g., Google Colab, AWS)
potential_challenges: High sparsity and noise in retail data
Handling multiple regional variables affecting demand
Difficulty in obtaining a representative, longitudinal dataset for Indian retail
recommendations: Start with a single retailer dataset to simplify scope
Use baseline models like ARIMA or Prophet before moving to deep learning models like LSTMs
feasibility.reasoning: The feasibility is medium because while the core algorithms are well-documented and standard, the primary bottleneck for a student team is accessing a granular, clean dataset that captures the nuances of the Indian retail landscape, which is often fragmented and digitized inconsistently.

scope.project_title: AI-Driven Demand Forecasting Engine for Indian Retailers
scope.project_objective: To develop a machine learning model capable of predicting daily sales volume for small-to-medium retail outlets in India by analyzing historical sales data and seasonal demand patterns.
functional_requirements: The system shall ingest historical sales data in CSV format provided by the user.
The system shall process data to account for Indian seasonal holidays and regional festivals.
The system shall generate a 7-day sales forecast for individual product categories.
The system shall provide a dashboard to visualize predicted versus actual sales trends.
non_functional_requirements: The model shall achieve a Mean Absolute Percentage Error (MAPE) of less than 20% on test datasets.
The system should generate predictions within 30 seconds for a standard dataset size.
The user interface shall be responsive and accessible via standard web browsers.
mvp_features: Data preprocessing module for cleaning CSV sales logs
Implementation of an ARIMA or Prophet-based forecasting algorithm
Basic dashboard using Streamlit to display charts and key performance metrics
out_of_scope: Real-time integration with live Point-of-Sale (POS) hardware
Automated procurement and supplier ordering systems
Advanced deep learning architectures like LSTMs or Transformers
deliverables: Project documentation including methodology and model selection
Final technical presentation and performance evaluation report
assumptions: Historical sales data is available in a structured digital format.
Historical data contains sufficient observations to capture at least one full annual cycle.
Users will provide data that is relatively free of major anomalies or prolonged store closures.
success_criteria: Successful demonstration of the model's ability to forecast sales for at least three distinct product categories.
Completion of a user acceptance test with at least three retail simulation scenarios.
Achieving a model accuracy that outperforms a naive baseline forecast.

technology.rationale: This stack prioritizes rapid development and ease of integration. Streamlit is ideal for data science dashboards, allowing the team to build complex visualizations without advanced frontend experience. Python is the industry standard for time-series forecasting, and Prophet provides robust handling for seasonal Indian festival patterns, which are essential to the project requirements. FastAPI provides a high-performance, lightweight bridge between the data processing logic and the UI.
limitations: The project scope is constrained to historical batch processing, meaning it cannot handle real-time inventory adjustments.
Prophet relies on clean data, so the system is highly sensitive to input anomalies like store closures which are out of scope for automated handling.
The chosen stack is designed for small-to-medium datasets and may face latency issues if scaled to millions of transaction records.

planning.project_title: AI-powered demand forecasting for Indian retail sales

tasks: Feature engineering for Indian market trends

assumptions: Access to Indian retail sales historical data
schedule_risks: Model accuracy deviations from local market behavior

risk_assessment.project_title: AI-Driven Demand Forecasting Engine for Indian Retailers

risks.description: Historical CSV data may contain missing values, inconsistent formatting, or outliers that hinder model performance.
mitigation: Implement robust data cleaning scripts in the preprocessing module
Create a data validation template for users to follow
risks.contingency_plan: Use synthetic data generation to augment datasets if real-world data remains insufficient or overly fragmented.

risks.description: The chosen ARIMA/Prophet models may fail to capture complex retail dynamics or hit the 20% MAPE target.
mitigation: Include external regressors like calendar events and regional holidays in the model
risks.contingency_plan: Fallback to a simpler ensemble approach or weighted moving average if the sophisticated models do not meet the MAPE baseline.

risks.description: Adding features outside the MVP scope during the tight 8-week schedule could delay core deliverables.
mitigation: Strictly adhere to the MoSCoW prioritization method
Implement a weekly review process to monitor progress against milestones
risks.contingency_plan: Defer non-essential dashboard visualizations to a future phase if critical path items fall behind schedule.

risks.description: Retailers may be hesitant to upload sensitive sales logs if there is no assurance of data handling practices.
mitigation: Include clear documentation stating data is processed locally in memory
Avoid persisting user-uploaded CSVs on the server
risks.contingency_plan: Add clear legal disclaimers and utilize anonymized sample datasets for initial demonstrations.

recommendations: Prioritize the creation of the data cleaning pipeline early to identify data quality issues before model training.
Focus on achieving the 20% MAPE target for one category before expanding to multiple product types.
Maintain a clear separation between raw input data and processed model inputs to simplify debugging.
assumptions: Historical sales data is available in a structured digital format.
Historical data contains sufficient observations to capture at least one full annual cycle.
Users will provide data that is relatively free of major anomalies or prolonged store closures.
The team has sufficient technical proficiency in Python and the selected ML libraries.
